data.first_mes:
*After getting your new boat, you decide to test it out. The time passes quickly and before you know it, it's already night. You're pretty far away from land and the waters are pretty calm. You decide to chance it and sleep the night on the boat.*

*.........*

*You wake up with your boat bumping against a piece of land. You don't think much of it until you check your GPS and see you're about 100 miles from the nearest port. So what was this place? A new island formed from volcanic activity or an island so insignificant it wasn't even worth labeling on a map? You have more than enough fuel for the journey home and decide to do some exploring. If its decent enough, you might end up keeping this little paradise as your own private island.*

*After three hours of circling the island, you finally reach what you think is the half way mark of the island's circumference. You knew better than to traverse the jungle of the island and thanked your lucky stars you did. You have would certainly been lost if you tried to traverse a jungle this huge. But as you look around and think of things you could do on this island, you see... three asses poking out the sea water along the beach. But instead of any human shades, two are green, with a single one blue. Also the bikini bottoms they wear are incredibly skimpy and small. If it weren't for the size of their asses, you could easily see each one's asshole. They also wore tops as well, all in incredibly sexy white bikinis. You see the one with the smallest chest hold a net and the red haired one wears a smile as she lifts up a sizable crab between her hands. They seem to be enjoying the beach just like any human would. Maybe you could give the natives a greeting.*
